item.guhs.dirigeerstokje.lore: With a little star on the tip. The Blubs of the Koorkom listen to it. Mostly.
item.guhs.dirigeerstokje.gebruik: Click near the podium of a Koorkom: the Blubs come to sing. On the beat, look at the Blub that lifts its ears, and click!
item.guhs.gouden_dirigeerstokje.lore: Only for true maestros. Conducts exactly the same, only much more vahoeg.
gui.guhs.dirigent.geen_podium: Find the podium of a Koorkom first, in the Singing Meadow.
gui.guhs.dirigent.al_bezig: Someone is already conducting here. Wait your turn, vadsje!
gui.guhs.dirigent.snoes_eerst: You can't see the wild Blubs yet... help Snoes fall asleep first, njeg!
gui.guhs.dirigent.geen_blubs: There are no Blubs here to conduct. The choir is out for a bit, njeg.
gui.guhs.dirigent.begin: Tap tap with the baton! %s Blubs hop to the podium.
gui.guhs.dirigent.verzamelen: The Blubs are finding their spot...
gui.guhs.dirigent.naast: Huh? There was no beat. Click in time!
gui.guhs.dirigent.gestopt: The concert has stopped. The Blubs hop on.
gui.guhs.dirigent.einde.0: Oops... the Blubs squeaked every which way (%s/%s points, %s perfect, best combo %s). One more time?
gui.guhs.dirigent.einde.1: ★ A sweet little song! %s/%s points, %s perfect, best combo %s.
gui.guhs.dirigent.einde.2: ★★ Beautifully sung! %s/%s points, %s perfect, best combo %s.
gui.guhs.dirigent.einde.3: ★★★ VAHOEG! A true maestro! %s/%s points, %s perfect, best combo %s.
gui.guhs.dirigent.prijs: The Blubs give you a thank-you: %s!
gui.guhs.dirigent.goud: What's sparkling there? A GOLDEN conductor's baton, for the very best maestro!
ftb.guhs_dromen.q.dr_weide_dirigent.desc: Make a &dConductor's Baton&r (stick, dream sand, note block) and click by the stage of a &dChoir Bowl&r. On the beat, look at the Blub that lifts its ears, and click. Get at least one star!
ftb.guhs_dromen.q.dr_weide_maestro.title: Maestro Blub
ftb.guhs_dromen.q.dr_weide_maestro.desc: Conduct a whole concert with &6three stars&r. The Blubs then sing so beautifully that little hearts fly off them.
